Got really lucky and found young turmeric at the farmers market. Knew I wanted to pickle and can it but you know, it can be hard to find canning recipes for these ethnic foods.

Scoured the internet and it seemed that everyone agrees that lemon or lime juice goes well with turmeric.

The Brine

  • 3/4 cup lemon juice - I used some I pasteurized and canned a few weeks before
  • 1 1/4 cane sugar
  • 1 1/3 white vinegar

Prepare the turmeric

  • Peel the roots. Fresh roots have thin skin you can remove with spoon.
  • Slice thinly-I use a mandolin
  • Salt lightly with pickling or sea salt. Let sit for 30 minutes turning occasionally *Boil some water to roiling boil and prepare a cheese cloth.
  • Blanch turmeric for 1 minute then dump in cheese cloth to cool.
  • Once turmeric is cool, squeeze the excess water.
  • Put in container of choice and pour hot brine on top. You can add a pinch of mustard and celery seed if you want.

I got 3 half pints out of 1 pound. Hot water bathed them for storage. Give them like a week.

Note: turmeric stains everything.
